name: Happiness! 2 Sakura Celebration
source:
"Once every ten years, the cherry blossoms stay in bloom longer than usual, and the seasonal festivals are much more grandiose. This year is known as the Year of the Cherry Blossoms.

With the arrival of the Year of the Cherry Blossoms once more, various people begin to feel various feelings sprout up again.

"It's been two years since I last saw Nii-san's face... This really is my home."

"I know he's better than that... This year, for sure, we'll see the real him."

"Can I do this? I have to, either way... I have to regain that relationship I lost."

"Alright. Preparations are complete... I won't let a catastrophe like that happen again."

And finally...

"It's been ten whole years since I was last here. I hope I get to see him again..."

These feelings meet and entangle, like flower petals swaying in the wind.

Right now, the various stories of those different people are set into motion. "

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2599880/Happiness_Sakura_Celebration/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“每隔十年，樱花就会比平时开放得更久，季节庆典也会盛大许多。今年被称为樱花之年。”

随着樱花之年再次到来，各种各样的人也开始再次感受到不同的情绪萌芽。

“已经两年没见到哥哥的脸了……这里果然是我的家。”

“我知道他不是那样的人……今年一定能看到真正的他。”

“我能做到吗？无论如何都必须做到……我一定要找回失去的那段关系。”

“好了，准备完成……我不会再让那种灾难发生。”

最后……

“我已经整整十年没来过这里了。希望能再次见到他……”

这些情感如随风摇曳的花瓣般相遇、交织。

此刻，属于不同人们的各种故事开始转动。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2599880/Happiness_Sakura_Celebration/]Steam[/url]]
